basic_info.description: Discover the perfect starter home in the heart of Ingleside! This charming, fully detached property features a cozy kitchen, a spacious 2-car garage, and a generous side yard—ideal for outdoor gatherings. The garage offers potential for expansion, with the possibility of adding an extra bedroom on the lower level. Enjoy ultimate convenience with the home’s prime location just one block from Ocean Ave’s shops, public transit, and close to major destinations like CCSF, SF State, Stonestown Galleria, Balboa Park BART, and I-280 freeway. With easy access to both Silicon Valley and Downtown San Francisco, this home is the ideal blend of comfort, practicality, and unbeatable location. Open house Friday 2/14 5pm- 6:30pm Saturday 2/15 2-4pm Sunday 2/16 2-4pm
